_doc: Operator/agent WATCH-BENCH: names you're monitoring for rotation/watch — NOT held (those are the book) and NOT peers (those live in research_cache/peer_set). The cockpit crawl's WATCH section shows these; the M5 orchestrator prices them via yfinance and injects them as `monitored` into build_matrix_state. Edit freely. Use YFINANCE ticker format — note unit/class shares use a DASH, not a dot (Sprott Uranium = U-UN.TO, not U.UN.TO).
